title: DGE circular Y1/12030/2024/DGE, 19 October 2024: 2024–25 Sasthrolsavam club competitions and named Science topics
provenance_limit: Public Google Drive reproduction discovered through a teacher index. The body bears the DGE/eOffice identifiers and visible signature block; no matching original-hosted body was located in the inspected October 2024 departmental posts. The mirror is not a separate official publisher.

visible_signature_block.validation_scope: Visible block inspected; cryptographic signature validity not tested.

evidence_locators.scope: Header/date; planned Alappuzha festival and district deadline; separately named NCERT one-day seminar.

State Science Talent Search date/place and separate HS/HSS topics; state C. V. Raman essay date/place and earlier deadlines. The paragraph gives essay 7 November and says it runs alongside Talent Search, whose earlier paragraph gives 8 November.
C. V. Raman essay progression and format, reference period, AI-website restriction, writing/interaction and evaluation basis.
Essay topics for school/subdistrict/revenue-district HS/HSS stages; state topic is separately provided at competition time.
Separate Mathematics Ramanujan Paper Presentation and Bhaskaracharya Seminar directions, topics and rubrics.
Separate Mathematics and Social Science Talent Search sections; circulation and visible signature.

review_scope: All twelve PDF pages rendered and read visually. Text extraction has damaged Malayalam glyphs; claims use the page images. No source PDF or render is copied into the repository.
scope_notes: Historical 2024–25 item-specific directions, not current 2026 entry instructions.
The ChatGPT/AI-assisted-website restriction appears within C. V. Raman essay directions; no prepared Science Working Model prohibition is inferred.
Mathematics Talent Search question counts on PDF10–12 must not be transferred to Science Talent Search.
The circular contains planned dates and event requirements; it is not proof of completion, a championship certificate or an explanation for changed result tables.
The printed English essay topic on PDF4 says Green energy and environment conversion, while the Malayalam wording concerns conservation; retain the difference rather than silently editing the source.

Internal PDF2 date inconsistency: Talent Search is dated 8 November and the essay 7 November, while the essay paragraph says it runs alongside the Talent Search examination. Neither date is silently corrected and a common day is not inferred.
notes: Public Drive reproduction of the dated 19 October 2024 DGE circular; all 12 pages rendered and read visually. Science Talent Search/C. V. Raman dates, topics and essay reference conditions are historical item directions. The essay-only AI website restriction is not a 2026 Working Model rule. Printed 7/8 November dates and alongside wording remain inconsistent. Later Mathematics/Social Science formats are separate. Visible signature inspected, not cryptographically validated; no official-hosted body or final championship statement recovered.
